analysis.title: Piper Sandler Cos. (PIPR): First Take: EPS miss on weaker top-line across Muni financing, Advisory, Equities
key_insights: PIPR reported adjusted 3Q26 EPS of $0.87, 5% below GSe of $0.91 and 7% below Visible Alpha consensus of $0.93.
Total revenue came in 2% below the Street. Investment banking revenue of $332mn was 4% below the Street, +1% YoY and -8% QoQ. GS expects a weaker investor reaction given the revenue miss.

Advisory fees of $250mn were 3% below consensus and up 18% YoY on higher average fees. Muni financing of $25mn was 42% below consensus and down 36% YoY, as higher interest rates reduced issuance activity.
Corporate financing of $57mn was 29% above consensus but down 29% YoY on fewer underwriting completions.

Institutional brokerage revenue of $114mn was 7% above consensus and +3% YoY. Fixed income was 20% above the Street and +5% YoY on higher client activity in an elevated rate environment. Equity brokerage was 4% below the Street and +1% YoY.

Adjusted operating margin was 19.8%, about 20bps below the Street. The non-comp ratio missed by about 30bps (up about 155bps YoY). The comp ratio was in line with the Street, flat QoQ and down about 20bps YoY.

GS looks for clarity on four items: the Advisory outlook for 4Q26 and 2027 (including sponsor and bank transaction appetite at higher rates), the cadence of underwriting, the trading outlook for the rest of 2026, and the ability to deliver operating leverage given the higher non-comp ratio.
GS rates PIPR Buy with a 12-month price target of $80 (13.5x Q5-Q8 P/E) against a $68.72 price, 16.4% upside. The target was lowered from $93 on 30-Jul-26 and was set at $80 on 01-Oct-26.

market_movers.rationale: GS reiterates Buy and the $80 target after a 3Q26 EPS miss, with 16.4% upside to the $68.72 close on 29 Oct 2026. Downside risks include slower IBanking and trading growth and weaker M&A backlogs.

earnings_insights: PIPR 3Q26 adjusted EPS reported (10/30): $0.87 vs GSe $0.91 and Visible Alpha consensus $0.93.

3Q26 reported revenue: investment banking $332mn (4% below consensus), Advisory $250mn (3% below), Muni financing $25mn (42% below), Corporate financing $57mn (29% above), Institutional brokerage $114mn (7% above), Fixed income 20% above consensus, Equities 4% below.
Adjusted operating margin reported at 19.8%, about 20bps below consensus. Non-comp ratio missed consensus by about 30bps. Comp ratio was in line with consensus.
Advisory Dealogic multiplier reported at 2.5x in 3Q26 vs 2.7x over the last four 3Qs.
GS estimates (GSe): EPS $4.65 for 12/26E, $5.62 for 12/27E and $6.38 for 12/28E. Quarterly GSe EPS: $0.91 for 9/26E (the quarter just reported), $1.69 for 12/26E, $1.18 for 3/27E; 6/26 EPS was $1.04.
risk_factors: Slower than expected growth in IBanking and trading.
Longer time to completion pushing out M&A and restructuring revenue.
Giving up prior market share gains.
A large cash build dragging on returns.
Higher interest rates weighing on Muni issuance and on sponsor and bank transaction appetite.
